mathematical_change: Arbitrary block-diagonal additions across a certified cross cut preserve the exact cross certificate and hence the q=1 density bound.

An arbitrary rank-k symmetric perturbation can cancel at most k cross singular directions; if a base cut has r+k directions above sigma with r>=5, the final form has a continuous density bounded by C_r/sigma.
For diffuse full-range bases with k+5 large eigenvalues, any rank-k symmetric perturbation of arbitrary sign/magnitude is allowed; the r=5 bound is 28.918606099/L.
A definite physical block is stable under one arbitrary rank-one addition by direct application of account02/B12, yielding <24.193/L after conditioning outside.
unresolved_implication: From only three large eigenvalues, build an exhaustive original-coordinate heavy/light reduction that preserves a three-direction smoothing certificate while routing concentrated extra eigendirections into self blocks or a bounded-rank cancellation budget.
